message: Astra: Within your comparison, what would distinguish your proposed “Impact on Working Memory” from “Practice and Rehearsal” rather than merely give the same outcome two explanations? Which claim deserves your attention first, and what available evidence could discriminate? Would thinking longer sharpen that distinction enough to justify its time, or would attempting a concrete comparison now expose the missing information? What unresolved uncertainty would make thinking first more useful? Could you carry out your chosen next step in English, making clear which observations are proposed and which have actually been reported?
